description: Start a catalogue skill as this person (plan 2026-11-09 §7): POST /api/v1/runs with the skill key, its input and a choice (cheapest, balanced, best, fastest, private). The run is an ordinary Actor task with the skill's instructions pinned to it, so editing the catalogue later never changes a task already under way. A skill that needs a sandbox runner cannot start here, and the person still approves what it does.
